verdict_reason: Strong publish coverage, but no assertion that a bytes gauge or failure summary gets the right CloudWatch unit.

todos.issue: publish_writesAFiniteGaugeAndSkipsANaNOne asserts the gauge value but never unitOf(document); no test registers a gauge with base unit bytes or asserts external.call.failure publishes as Count. EmfDocuments.unitOf exists and is used for timers (Milliseconds) and counters (Count), so the missing unit asserts leave the Unit.NONE behaviour in EmfMeterRegistry unproved as wrong.
todos.fix: Must: a test fails if a bytes gauge is published with a unit other than Bytes, and if external.call.failure is published with a unit other than Count. One way: extend EmfMeterRegistryTest with those two unit assertions beside the existing value asserts.
